## Review Complete

**VERDICT: Not ready to ship.** The app lacks all three MVP features (view, add, remove inventory), has no build configuration (missing vite.config.js and index.html), and contains only placeholder tests.

**What I verified:**
- App currently renders static "Inventory" text with zero functional code
- No data model, state management, or persistence layer defined
- No input handling or user interaction implemented
- Tests are placeholders asserting nothing about actual behavior
- Critical infrastructure missing: build config and HTML entry point
- Multiple architecture decisions left undefined (data source, persistence, authentication)

Detailed findings saved to REVIEW.md.
